items.question_text: Which of the following sentences correctly uses negative inversion?
options: A) Not only did the experiment fail, but it also caused significant damage.
B) Not only the experiment failed, but it also caused significant damage.
C) Not only failed the experiment, but it also caused significant damage.
D) Not only the experiment did fail, but it also caused significant damage.

independent_ai_review.evidence_quote_or_justification: When 'Not only' introduces a clause, subject-auxiliary inversion is mandatory. Because the base declarative clause contains no auxiliary verb ('the experiment failed'), do-support ('did') must be inserted before the subject NP ('the experiment'), followed by the bare infinitive ('fail'). Option A correctly realizes this structure. Options B, C, and D exhibit lack of inversion, illicit full lexical verb inversion, and uninverted emphatic order respectively.
independent_ai_review.reviewer_rationale: When 'Not only' introduces a clause, subject-auxiliary inversion is mandatory. Because the base declarative clause contains no auxiliary verb ('the experiment failed'), do-support ('did') must be inserted before the subject NP ('the experiment'), followed by the bare infinitive ('fail').
